login.description: Sign in with email and password

checkAccount.description: Check if an email already has an account

checkVerified.description: Check if an email is verified

me.description: Current user profile and role from database

checkGym.description: Check if gym name/city or phone already exists for a gym owner

pendingAdmins.description: List pending and approved admin accounts from the database

listUsers.description: List member accounts for gym admins (all users for super admin)

updateUser.description: Update a member profile or membership

monthlyMembers.description: List gym monthly members with fee and days left

platformSettings.description: Get platform facility fee from database

updatePlatformSettings.description: Save platform facility fee to database

create.description: Create a default profile if missing

uploadAvatar.description: Upload profile avatar to Supabase storage bucket

uploadGymMedia.description: Upload gym main/optional image or video to gym-media bucket

get.description: Fetch workout days, exercises, PRs and stats

save.description: Upsert workout day focus or create a personal record

addExercise.description: Add an exercise with sets and reps to a workout day

exerciseCatalog.description: List exercises for a focus (wger public API + local fallback)

exerciseDemo.description: Resolve a YouTube form demo for an exercise name

deleteExercise.description: Delete a workout exercise by id

deleteRecord.description: Delete a personal record by id
